items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

ctx.x: And that's uh, must be Duck, Duck's Ernest's father, huh?
No, that's, my brother Ernest, see we're about the same mother, a different father. I see. See, uh, he's, he's a Johnson and I'm a Bailey.

items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: My brother Duck Onions. He called him Duck Onions. Bass player in the pool too. ... the one who's playing with us now.

ctx.x: So I know both of them. And he know my brother, the one who's playing with us now. Kappa. He know my brother. My brother Duck Onions. He called him Duck Onions. Bass player in the pool too. Boy I take that bass when we be playing you know. I got a track car belt right there tune in C. And we get there and he get on that bass, take that bass and turn it all around like that you know. I throw sticks up in there and catch me. When I was younger I used to jump in a chair and run all around and come back. Cheek don't…
You're juggling acting at the same time.
